keeps: NOT THE CHEAP SYNTHETIC STUFF I'M USED TO GETTING IN THE SLUMS.
SINCE IT COST ME EVERYTHING I HAD LEFT...
AFTER ALL, MY LIFE IS COMING TO AN END.
DAMN! THIS IS WAY TOO BITTER.
I SHOULD'VE JUST BOUGHT A PIECE OF REAL MEAT INSTEAD.
WELL... IT'S GOING TO KEEP ME AWAKE, AT LEAST.
MAKE IT TO THE POLICE STATION...
AS DEMANDED BY THE THIRD SPECIAL DIRECTIVE...
I AM HERE TO SURRENDER MYSELF AS A CARRIER OF THE NIGHTMARE SPELL.
ATTENTION! CODE BLACK IN THE LOBBY!
BACK THEN, THE PLANET WAS JUST STARTING TO RECOVER FROM A SERIES OF DEVASTATING NATURAL DISASTERS AND SUBSEQUENT RESOURCE WARS.
BUT WHEN ITS VICTIMS BEGAN FALLING INTO AN ENDLESS SLUMBER, THE WORLD TOOK NOTICE.
IT LOOKED LIKE AN ILLNESS THAT CAUSED CONSTANT FATIGUE AND SLEEPINESS.
EVENTUALLY, THIS PHENOMENON CAME TO BE KNOWN AS THE NIGHTMARE SPELL, AND IT WAS NO MERE DISEASE.
THE SPELL WAS A KIND OF MAGIC... OR A CURSE.
THOSE WHO DIED IN THEIR SLEEP TRANSFORMED INTO MONSTERS.
THESE CREATURES STARTED HUNTING HUMANS INDISCRIMINATELY.
BEFORE LONG, THE WORLD WAS SWALLOWED BY DESPAIR AND CHAOS.
...PEOPLE WHO HAD FALLEN ASLEEP BEGAN TO WAKE UP.
THEY HAD SURVIVED THEIR FIRST NIGHTMARE...
WITH THE MIRACULOUS POWERS THEY EARNED BY OVERCOMING TRIALS INSIDE THE NIGHTMARE...
...THEY PUSHED BACK THE MONSTERS AND RESTORED A SEMBLANCE OF PEACE.
IN TIME, THE AWAKENED BECAME HUMANITY'S HOPE.
AND A NEW WORLD ORDER STARTED TO FORM.
TO PREPARE FOR THE POSSIBILITY THAT STUDENTS MIGHT BE INFECTED,
SCHOOLS BEGAN TEACHING SKILLS NEEDED FOR SURVIVAL AND COMBAT.
THE WEALTHY EVEN PAID ENORMOUS SUMS OF MONEY...
SO THEIR CHILDREN COULD RECEIVE SPECIAL TRAINING FOR BECOMING AWAKENED.
FURTHERMORE, CHILDREN BORN INTO POWERFUL AWAKENED FAMILIES...
COULD WIELD INHERITED MAGICAL MEMORIES OR ECHOES IN THEIR FIRST VISIT TO THE DREAM REALM.
THAT HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH A SLUM RAT LIKE ME.
FOR ME, BEING CHOSEN BY THE SPELL IS NOTHING BUT A DEATH SENTENCE.
SUNLESS... BUT PEOPLE CALL ME SUNNY.
I WAS BORN DURING A SOLAR ECLIPSE.
MY MOM HAD A POETIC SOUL, YOU SEE.
DO YOU WANT US TO CONTACT YOUR FAMILY?
HOW MUCH LONGER CAN YOU STAY AWAKE?
LISTEN CAREFULLY AND TRY TO HANG ON.
HOW MUCH DO YOU REALLY KNOW ABOUT THE NIGHTMARE SPELL?
JUST GO INTO THE DREAM REALM, KILL A FEW MONSTERS...
...THEN GET MAGIC POWERS AND BECOME AN AWAKENED, RIGHT?
SO YOU KNOW THE BASICS, AT LEAST.
INSIDE YOUR FIRST NIGHTMARE, YOU'LL RUN INTO MONSTERS, SURE, BUT YOU WILL ALSO MEET PEOPLE.
REMEMBER: THEY'RE JUST ILLUSIONS MEANT TO TEST YOU.
YOU MIGHT HAVE TO KILL THEM, KID.
SO DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND JUST THINK ABOUT THEM AS ILLUSIONS.
THE MOMENT YOU ENTER THE NIGHTMARE,
IF YOU GET A COMBAT-ORIENTED ASPECT, LIKE A SWORDSMAN OR AN ARCHER,
THINGS WILL BE A LOT EASIER FOR YOU.
BUT EVEN IF YOU RECEIVE AN ASPECT UNRELATED TO COMBAT, DON'T DESPAIR.
THERE ARE REALLY NO USELESS ASPECTS.
AFTER ALL, THE SPELL SETS UP TRIALS, NOT EXECUTIONS.
SO JUST DO ANYTHING IN YOUR POWER TO SURVIVE.
WHAT YOU DO DURING THE TRIAL WILL DETERMINE THE REWARDS AND POWERS THAT WILL BE WAITING FOR YOU, IF YOU SUCCEED.
...YOU BECOME A GATE THROUGH WHICH A MONSTER APPEARS IN THE REAL WORLD.
IF THAT HAPPENS, MY COLLEAGUES AND I WILL HAVE TO DEAL WITH IT.
OR AT LEAST... DON'T DIE RIGHT AWAY.
IT'LL TAKE A FEW HOURS FOR THE NEAREST AWAKENED TO GET HERE.
SO WE WOULD REALLY APPRECIATE IT IF YOU DIDN'T MAKE US FIGHT THAT THING OURSELVES...
ASPIRANT! WELCOME TO THE NIGHTMARE SPELL.

manual.text: THAT'S WHAT THEY USED TO SAY...
